app_tagline: [اردو] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [اردو] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [اردو] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [اردو] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [اردو] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [اردو] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [اردو] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [اردو] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [اردو] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [اردو] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [اردو] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [اردو] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [اردو] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [اردو] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [اردو] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [اردو] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [اردو] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [اردو] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [اردو] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [اردو] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [اردو] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [اردو] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [اردو] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [اردو] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [اردو] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [اردو] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [اردو] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [اردو] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [اردو] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [ur] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [ur] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [ur] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [ur] Type or speak your question for the helper...
